newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian pensioners block trains in protest.
newsitem.headline: Russian pensioners block trains in protest.

text.p: About 50 angry pensioners blocked a railway line in central Russia on Tuesday and held up trains for more than five hours to demand their pensions be paid, Itar-Tass news agency said.
It said the group blocked the railway line from 1 p.m. Moscow time (1000 GMT) until about 6 p.m. (1515) in the Kalinin district near Tver, 150 km (90 miles) northwest of Moscow.
Passenger and cargo trains were halted while they stood on the rails, the agency said, adding that it was the third time the pensioners had resorted to such protests in little more than three months.
Some Russians have not received their pensions or wages for several months and protests have erupted sporadically across the country.
The government blames the delays on tax evasion but President Boris Yeltsin has criticised the cabinet and ordered a reshuffle.
